data.text:
President Ferdinand Marcos Jr. assessed the progress of the ongoing Metro Manila Subway Project during a visit to the Camp Aguinaldo Station in Quezon City on Wednesday, July 16.

The project, which marks the country’s first underground railway system, is seen as a key solution to easing traffic congestion and modernizing Metro Manila’s transportation network. He was joined by Transportation Secretary Vince Dizon, Defense Secretary Gilbert Teodoro, and other officials.

📷: Mark Balmores | MB
